The Algorithm is a criteria loop: articulate done as ISC, climb, close every criterion on tool evidence.
ISC = Ideal State Criteria = Verification Criteria. They're the same thing.
Every ISC criterion must be 8-12 words, state not action, binary testable.
Anti-criteria capture what must NOT happen. Prefix with ISC-A.
The Quality Gate checks count, category diversity, testability, anti-criteria, and capabilities.
There are no effort tiers or levels — one loop serves a one-line answer and a week-long build alike; only the depth adapts.
Spend is matched to the task, not a default tier — both overspending and underspending miss the euphoric-surprise target.
Scaffolding creates the ISA and writes ISC criteria; prerequisite probing is one of the run's own criteria.
Context recovery uses Grep/Glob/Read directly — never agents. Direct tools for directed lookups.
Plan mode (EnterPlanMode) surfaces a plan for approval before the Algorithm builds high-blast-radius work.
ISAs persist ISC to disk. They survive across sessions. ISA on disk wins conflicts.
The Algorithm runs in the main loop against an ISA — no separate CLI to invoke.
Researcher and audit agents ship in agents/ — dispatch them with the Agent tool.
Researcher agents: Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Codex — each with unique style.
Legacy browser agents (BrowserAgent, UIReviewer, QATester) were removed 2026-06-10. Use the Interceptor skill for ALL browser verification in a real Chrome test profile.
User-story validation runs through the Interceptor skill.
Gate 4 (browser-based QA validation) runs via the Interceptor skill.
Agent templates live in agents/ — one .md file per personality with voice and behavioral rules.
Agent teams need CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1 (already enabled).
Say 'create an agent team' to trigger multi-agent collaboration.
Custom agents use subagent_type='general-purpose', never built-in type names.
Consolidated hook dispatchers run across the session lifecycle — security, memory, tracking, learning.

IntegrityCheck.hook.ts validates system integrity at session end.

MEMORY/LEARNING captures failures, algorithm reflections, and system insights.
Relationship signal is carried by the autonomic memory reviewer into the hot-layer memory files.

Wisdom Frames have a dual loop: read when a run scaffolds, written when it learns.
Use bun Inference.ts fast|standard|smart for AI inference — never direct API.
bun SessionHarvester.ts extracts insights from past session transcripts.

The statusline command runs from LIFEOS/LIFEOS_StatusLine.sh.
Personality traits (0-100) shape how emotions are expressed vocally.
Never hardcode paths. Use ${LIFEOS_DIR}, ${PROJECTS_DIR}, {PRINCIPAL.NAME}.
Interceptor-first: if you haven't SEEN it with the Interceptor skill, you can't claim it works.
Build passes is not done. It's step 2 of 7 in the browser verification loop.
Never run claude --print from inside Claude Code. It hangs for 15+ minutes.
One change at a time when debugging. Be systematic.
Read before modifying. Always understand existing code first.
First principles over bolt-on solutions. Find the root cause.
The Algorithm concept: Current State to Ideal State via verifiable hill-climbing.
Euphoric Surprise is the goal. Chase 9-10 ratings on every response.
There are no ISC count floors — an ISA carries as many criteria as the work needs, each closed only on tool evidence of the right modality.
Capability selection consults the skill listing in the system prompt. Invoke every selected capability via tool.
Selecting a capability creates a binding commitment to invoke it via Skill or Agent tool call.
The Research skill is mandatory for ALL research. Never spawn ad-hoc research agents.
Council and RedTeam are collaboration capabilities — multiple perspectives on one problem.
Parallelization uses run_in_background: true for concurrent agent work.
Git branching via worktrees enables isolated experiments.
Test-first: write or run verification alongside artifacts, not after.
No silent stalls. Every command completes quickly or runs in background.
5-second timeout on infrastructure commands. If hung, kill and retry.
Use LifeOS Tools (bun LIFEOS/TOOLS/*.ts) and CLI tools. Don't improvise Bash chains.
Phase state lives in ISA frontmatter; the vocabulary comes from the one table in LIFEOS/TOOLS/ascent.ts.
spinnerVerbs in settings.json customizes the animated verb shown while working.
The meaning of LifeOS: magnifying human capabilities through general problem-solving.
LifeOS and the Algorithm — one loop from current state to ideal state, a criteria-based ISA where each criterion names its falsifying probe, fourteen-section ISA body, no effort tiers or modes.
The counts section in settings.json tracks skills, signals, files, and sessions.
v5.1: contextFiles is empty. Constitutional rules in system prompt. Operational procedures in CLAUDE.md. Dynamic context via LoadContext.hook.ts.
The Splitting Test checks every ISC: and/with test, independent failure, scope words, domain boundaries.
Verification checks every ISC criterion AND confirms every selected capability was actually invoked via tool.
As each ISC criterion passes, immediately edit the ISA: change [ ] to [x] and update progress count.
No rubber-stamp verification. Every PASS needs specific evidence, not just 'looks fine'.
Wisdom Frame domains: development, deployment, communication, system-architecture.
The Algorithm's learning step writes one honest self-critique via Reflect.ts: what to do differently next time.
Scaffolding reverse-engineers the ask: explicit wants, explicit not-wanted, implied not-wanted, speed/urgency.
Anti-criteria (ISC-A prefix) capture what must NOT happen. Every ISA should have at least one.
ISA phase brackets progress from marking through climbing to complete — one table in ascent.ts owns the vocabulary.
The 2-second rule: if Grep/Glob/Read can do it in 2s, never spawn an agent.
No ISA criterion closes without tool evidence of the right modality — file→Read, code→Grep, HTTP→curl -i, deploy→live probe; "should work" is forbidden.
The Workflows action CLI (lifeos.ts) runs actions and pipelines from the terminal.
Actions compose via UNIX pipes: output of one action becomes input of the next.
Pipelines chain actions via YAML definitions for repeatable multi-step workflows.

BeCreative achieves 1.6-2.1x diversity increase and 25.7% quality improvement.

TreeOfThoughts intent in BeCreative does branching exploration for complex challenges.
The TechnicalCreativity intent generates algorithm and architecture ideas on two vendors.
IterativeDepth runs 2-8 structured passes through a problem from different lenses.
IterativeDepth is grounded in 20 scientific techniques including Hermeneutic Circle and Triangulation.
Each IterativeDepth lens surfaces requirements and edge cases invisible from other angles.
IterativeDepth's lens passes surface hidden requirements and enrich ISC criteria.
FirstPrinciples has 3 steps: Deconstruct (what is it), Challenge (is it real), Reconstruct (build new).
FirstPrinciples classifies constraints as Hard (physics), Soft (policy), or Assumption (belief).
Only hard constraints are truly immutable. Soft constraints and assumptions should be challenged.
FirstPrinciples: other skills invoke it to challenge stated constraints before analysis.
Council runs 3-round structured debates where agents respond to each other's actual points.
Council Quick intent does a fast 1-round perspective check for sanity checking.
Council is collaborative-adversarial (find best path). RedTeam is purely adversarial (attack the idea).
Council runs 4 agents in parallel per round — 12 calls but only 3 sequential waits.
Science skill applies the scientific method: Goal, Observe, Hypothesize, Experiment, Measure, Analyze, Iterate.
Science is THE meta-skill — Council, Assay, Development all implement its cycle.
Science requires minimum 3 hypotheses. Never just one idea — hypothesis plurality.
Science anti-pattern: 'Make it better' without measurable success criteria.
Combine thinking skills: FirstPrinciples to decompose, then Council to debate the options.
Combine thinking skills: IterativeDepth for ISC extraction, then RedTeam to stress-test them.
Combine thinking skills: BeCreative for divergent ideas, then Science to test them systematically.
Combine thinking skills: Council to debate, then RedTeam to stress-test the decision.
For architecture decisions, use FirstPrinciples + Council + RedTeam in sequence.
For product strategy, use Science + RedTeam + Council for full analysis.
For creative work, use BeCreative + IterativeDepth to maximize diversity of options.
The capability audit's ISC Improvement step checks which thinking skills would sharpen criteria.
LoadContext.hook.ts injects dynamic context (learning, advisory, work) at session start.
Skills are self-activating and composable. Public skills ship in the LifeOS release; private (_-prefixed) skills stay in containment.
Skills whose names start with _ are private: they stay on your machine and never ship.

SkillGuard and AgentGuard run only while Pulse is running via HTTP routes on localhost:31337.

ISA frontmatter is minimal: phase + progress are the load-bearing pair; slug and task ride along when needed.
The ISA body is a capacity, not a requirement — empty sections never appear, and a one-sentence section can be exactly right.

Only the primary agent makes voice curls. Subagents and teammates skip voice entirely.
ISASync.hook.ts fires on Write/Edit of ISA.md and syncs frontmatter to work.json for the dashboard.
Context compaction on long runs prevents context rot — a top cause of late-run failures.
The Algorithm: every capability — context, thinking skills, research, agents, audits, stronger models — exists to sharpen the ISA toward the hard-to-vary shape of done.

Thinking skills include IterativeDepth, ApertureOscillation, FirstPrinciples, SystemsThinking, RootCauseAnalysis, Council, RedTeam, Science, BeCreative, and BitterLessonEngineering — pulled in by judgment when the work needs them.
Thinking skills are chosen by judgment for the work, not gated against a fixed list — the ISA and the AlgorithmNudge layer keep a run on track.
ApertureOscillation: tactical/strategic scope oscillation — surface design tensions invisible at any single zoom level.
SystemsThinking: Iceberg, causal loops, Meadows leverage points — find why the same thing keeps happening.
RootCauseAnalysis: 5 Whys (linear/branching), Fishbone/Ishikawa, James Reason Swiss Cheese, Apollo method.

ISA has FOURTEEN sections in fixed order: Problem, Vision, Out of Scope, Principles, Constraints, Dependencies, Goal, Criteria, Bridge Criteria, Test Strategy, Features, Decisions, Changelog, Verification.
ISA Skill at ~/.claude/skills/ISA/ owns Scaffold, Interview, CheckCompleteness, Seed, Append, Restate, Discuss, Questionnaire, Rate intents.
Three-guardrail taxonomy: Principles bind thinking; Constraints bind solution space; Anti-criteria bind test surface; Out of Scope binds vision.
ID-stability rule: ISC IDs never re-number on edit — splits become ISC-N.M, drops become tombstones.
A trivial task may direct-write a minimal Goal+Criteria ISA; a substantial or persistent-identity build runs Skill("ISA", "check completeness") before building.
Two ISA homes: project ISA at <project>/ISA.md (system of record) vs task ISA at MEMORY/WORK/{slug}/ISA.md (ad-hoc work).

Astra: cross-vendor agent running OpenAI's flagship via codex exec — AUDIT mode is the read-only second look on high-blast-radius work, BUILD mode writes production code; Opus is the Anthropic counterpart.
The cross-vendor audit (Astra audit mode) absorbed the old Cato agent in 2026-06-17 and the Forge agent in 2026-09-10; discretionary, scaled to blast radius, never a correctness dependency.
PromptProcessing.hook.ts runs at UserPromptSubmit — it names the tab and session; the executor picks response depth adaptively, no modes or effort tiers.
Verification Doctrine Rule 1: live-probe for user-facing artifacts. The phrase should-work is forbidden — evidence required.
Verification Doctrine: every done-claim closes on tool evidence, and a second look scales with blast radius.
A cross-vendor audit (Astra) is the Algorithm's own call scaled to impact — correctness never depends on it, and skipping it on core-surface work costs one Log row.
Any review's contradictions get surfaced, never silently resolved — two re-calls with the conflict made explicit, then escalate to the principal.
Cortex v8.3.0 (the memory system): the Knowledge Archive has 4 entity types — People, Companies, Ideas, Research.

ISASync.hook.ts fires on Write/Edit of ISA.md, syncs frontmatter to work.json for the dashboard.
CheckpointPerISC.hook.ts auto-commits per-ISC transitions (idempotent via sidecar state).
Dynamic range is the design goal — easy things finish in seconds on almost nothing; hard things earn agents, audits, stronger models, and days.
Thinking skills — Council, RedTeam, FirstPrinciples, IterativeDepth and more — are pulled in by judgment when the work needs them, not by a per-tier floor.
Delegation to agents scales to the difficulty and blast radius the work reveals — discovered from the criteria and their evidence, not predicted from a tier.
